annotations.title: Add company filings to a proof ledger

description: Add what companies filed to a signed, append-only ledger: each figure with its filing, and a restatement line whenever a later filing changes one. Re-running adds only what is new. It shows the lines were not altered afterwards, not that a figure is right.

key_file.description: Signing key (PEM); created if new. Default ~/.canli/proof-key.pem.

ledger_file.description: The ledger file; started if new.
